If youVerdictBecause
You need memory this monthBuy nowNo forecaster on record sees meaningful relief before late 2027. Waiting costs you the upside of a falling market that nobody is forecasting.Gartner, Counterpoint Research, Intel
You can wait one quarterBuy nowTrendForce expects DRAM contract prices to keep rising through 2026, and the chip spot market set a fresh record in the week of July 21. A quarter of waiting is a quarter of paying more.TrendForce
You can wait a full yearBuy now, but watch the equity signalGartner sees no meaningful relief before late 2027 and Counterpoint puts the earliest realistic inflection at Q4 2027, so a year of waiting probably still lands you in a tight market. The one genuine counter-signal is that memory-maker equities have already rolled over.Gartner, Counterpoint Research
Your platform takes DDR4Buy DDR4, and buy it nowAt retail DDR4 still costs about 58% less per GB than DDR5, so the older platform is the cheap escape hatch even though DDR4 is in the worse supply squeeze. That discount is the thing most at risk: fabs are winding DDR4 down, and its chip spot price is the one setting records.TrendForce spot data, RAM Prices USA
You are speccing an AI or local-LLM machineBuy less, faster memory than you plannedCapacity is what got expensive. Dropping one tier of capacity saves more than dropping a speed grade, because the per-GB price is what moved, not the per-module premium for speed.Derived from the per-GB retail spread above
